one_line: Six colour-coded mutant frogs that players can buy from cargo or find as loot, each with a small gimmick (glowing, heating items, charging devices, exuding water) and a poison type on bite/butcher.
player_facing_mechanics: Frogs can be picked up and carried as held mobs (on_picked_up hooks)
Albino frog: plain pickup only, no special effect
Glow frog: emits green light when alive and makes the item holding it emit green light
Plasma frog: is hot, can be used via secondary/right click on an item to ignite it (fire_act 500,10) and prints a notice; heats the item when picked up; is lava-immune and tolerates any temperature

Supermatter frog: has a charge port; drag an allowed device onto it and it is stored and slowly recharged (energy guns, security batons, recharge ammo magazines, modular computers); pings when done; clicking it with an empty hand drops the stored device
Recharge magazines stored in it regain ammo; energy guns/modular computers get their cell topped up by chargerate per tick
Dew frog: holds 400 units of water, adds 2 water per Life tick, and exposes/secretes water onto its turf as it moves
Each frog has a bite/reagent poison type (uranium, stable plasma, teslium, water, none)
Cargo can order an 'Exotic Frog Crate' (frog crate) for CARGO_CRATE_VALUE * 2 containing 3 random exotic frogs
Frogs spawn from a random loot spawner placed in maint loot, hydroponics/fishing trays, and the cargo crate

red: on_picked_up heating the item, attackby_secondary calling weapon.fire_act with notice, Initialize adding lava-immune trait

port_notes: Most surface values (names, sprites, poison reagent, crate contents/cost, spawner table) port directly to SS14 YAML prototypes, but every variant's gimmick needs real code. The base behaviour maps to an NPC prototype plus components/systems: glow becomes a PointLightComponent (and a pickup/held-item light), the charging frog becomes a component with an update-loop that drains/charges a battery/ammo and reacts to a drag-drop interaction, the dew frog becomes a component that exposes and consumes a solution on movement (and on life tick), and the red frog's secondary-click ignition maps to an Ignition/temperature system interaction. The cargo crate maps to a cargo product and the spawner to an entity-spawner/entity-table. Open questions for a human: how to represent 'drag item onto mob' and the allowed-device whitelist, whether held-mob light/heat transfer is worth supporting, what poison/butcher reagent semantics replace poison_type, and whether the per-tick water secretion should be event-driven or ran on a periodic system.
